title: dodag.rs: select_parent admissible() lacks candidate_admissible floor checks; unjoined node joins through above-root parent
description: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs. The method DodagState::admissible() (used by select_parent/prune_inadmissible_parents) only checks path_cost saturation and MaxRankIncrease, while free fn candidate_admissible() additionally rejects rank < min_hop_rank_increase (above-root ranks) and DAGRank(cost) <= DAGRank(candidate.rank). A fresh/unjoined node (rank=INFINITE, lowest_rank=INFINITE) receiving a same-version DIO advertising rank < MinHopRankIncrease (e.g. rank 100 with default MHRI 256) has it inserted into parents and joins through it at rank 356, below the root rank floor of 256. Reachable via public API: DodagState::new + process_dio(dio(100), etx 1.0). Fix direction: make admissible() apply the same DAGRank/floor rules as candidate_admissible(). Found during project-LICHEN-worker6-26l6.12 analysis.
